title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to build machine learning solutions that solve real business problems for clients across banking and financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. You will work with data from understanding the business problem to building, testing, and deploying models, and you will explain the results to business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand business problems and turn them into data science solutions
* Build, test, and improve machine learning models (for example churn prediction, fraud detection, credit risk, forecasting, customer segmentation)
* Prepare and clean data, create features, and choose the right evaluation metrics for each problem
* Deploy models with engineering teams and monitor their performance over time
* Present results and recommendations clearly to clients and business teams
* Guide and support junior team members where needed

**RequiredExperience and Skills**

* 10+ years of experience, with most of it in hands-on data science (not only reporting or analytics)
* Strong hands-on experience in at least one of: classification (such as churn, fraud, credit risk, propensity), regression/forecasting, or clustering/segmentation
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, and in libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM
* Good understanding of statistics and model evaluation (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and handling imbalanced data)
* Ability to explain a project end to end: the problem, the data, the model, the result, and the business impact
* Strong communication and stakeholder skills

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or RAG applications
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and model deployment (MLOps)
* Domain experience in banking and financial services, retail, or healthcare
* Experience leading or mentoring a small team

**Education**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field will be preferred.

Pay: ₹3,500,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Applied Scientist I, International Seller Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a stellar Machine Learning scientist who has 1+ years of industry experience developing and shipping large scale ML products with visible customer impact. We would prefer if your previous work has been in developing scalable Agentic, RL or forecasting systems. Strong academic background in Statistics, Machine Learning & Deep Learning is required with Tier -1 publications being a plus.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this position, you will be a key contributor (with direct leadership visibility) building, productionizing (real & batch) and measuring impact of state of the art personalized Gen AI systems for Amazon global selling partners and contribute to Amazon wide research in this area in the form of publications and white papers. You will work with global leaders and teams across time zones on a regular basis.  
  
  
  
  
About the team  
Millions of Sellers list their products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. In this ecosystem our team plays a critical role in enabling Sellers across EU5, China, Japan, Australia, Brazil and Turkey to make their Selection available to customers globally and deliver the experience they have come to expect from Amazon.  
  
In Jeff’s own words (2019 Q1 shareholders letter): “Something strange and remarkable has happened over the last 20 years. Take a look at these numbers: 1999 - 3% …… 2018 - 58%. The % represent the share of physical gross merchandise sales sold on Amazon by independent third-party sellers – mostly small- and medium-sized businesses – as opposed to Amazon retail's own first party sales. Third-party sales have grown from 3% of the total to 58%. To put it bluntly: Third-party sellers are kicking our first party butt. Badly.…. Why were independent sellers able to grow so much faster than Amazon's own highly organized first-party sales organization? There isn't one answer, but we do know one extremely important part of the answer: We helped independent sellers compete against our first-party business by investing in and offering them the very best selling tools we could imagine and build.
  
Our team is pushing the boundaries of these machine learning tools in areas of Agentic, recommendation and forecasting systems to help our sellers sell more and across borders.

title: Applied Scientist II, Amazon Business - External Integrations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.  
  
Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.  
Key job responsibilities  
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.  
  
Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.  
  
Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.  
  
Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Master's degree, or PhD

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.

* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Preferred qualifications:**
